# Portable UI: standard C++ and LVGL only. Built as an ESP-IDF component for the device,
# and as a plain CMake library for the desktop simulator and host tests (sim/).
set(UI_SOURCES src/app.cpp src/dashboard.cpp src/eye_model.cpp src/eyes.cpp src/info.cpp src/round_layout.cpp
    src/status_bar.cpp src/timer_pages.cpp
    # generated by tools/fonts.sh
    fonts/inter_14.c fonts/inter_20.c fonts/inter_28.c fonts/inter_40.c
    fonts/inter_digits_72.c fonts/inter_digits_96.c fonts/icons_24.c fonts/icons_48.c)

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
    idf_component_register(SRCS ${UI_SOURCES} INCLUDE_DIRS include REQUIRES app_core)
else()
    add_library(ui STATIC ${UI_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(ui PUBLIC include)
    target_compile_features(ui PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    target_link_libraries(ui PUBLIC lvgl app_core)
endif()
